title: Charming Way - Charming 30A
meta_description: Welcome to Charming 30A, a bright and breezy 4BDR retreat tucked just a five-minute stroll from the sugar-white sands of Dune Allen Beach.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Charming 30A, a bright and breezy beach retreat tucked just a five-minute stroll from the sugar-white sands of Dune Allen Beach. Set along a quiet, welcoming street while still close to 30A's favorite cafés, coastal shops, and scenic bike paths, this home blends relaxation and convenience in a way that makes every day feel like vacation.

Inside, soft coastal hues, modern finishes, and abundant natural light create a refreshing, open atmosphere. The main living area flows easily into a beautifully designed kitchen featuring sleek appliances, ample counter space, a Keurig, and a dining area perfect for group meals. An additional upstairs lounge offers a second TV and a cozy spot for movie nights, kids' hangouts, or extra breathing room during longer stays.

Each bedroom at Charming 30A offers its own peaceful haven after sun-soaked days on the coast. Two king suites provide spacious comfort with private ensuite bathrooms. A third ensuite bedroom features a twin-over-full bunk with a twin trundle---perfect for kids or friends sharing space---while the fourth bedroom includes a cozy queen bed. A sleeper sofa in the upstairs lounge provides extra sleeping space to accommodate large groups.

Outside, the large covered balcony invites all-day relaxation with a swinging daybed, hightop table, and grill for evening BBQs. An outdoor shower adds a convenient touch after beach days, and exploring 30A's charming beach towns is effortless.

Escape to Charming 30A, a thoughtfully designed getaway for groups seeking comfort, style, and easy access to the best of the Emerald Coast!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: Gulf Place Plaza, The Big Chill 30A, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach, Stinky's Fish Camp

Home Truths:
- Please note that the maximum occupancy for this home is 12 guests. Ensure that the total number of guests adheres to the specified occupancy limit.
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. Strictly no pets are allowed unless registered ADA service animals. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a $500 fine per pet.
- You must be 25 years old to book this property.

Parking Details:
- Driveway parking is available for 2 vehicles.
- Additional parking is available in the community parking areas at the front of the neighborhood.
- Street parking is not allowed. The HOA will tow vehicles parked on the street.

Accidental Damage Protection: A non-refundable accidental damage protection plan has been included in the price of your reservation. Under this plan, you will not be held responsible to pay for accidental damage or loss to the rental property resulting from you or others in your party up to $2000. This plan does not cover intentional acts of a guest, gross negligence, or willful and wanton conduct, and/or damages caused by pets. This plan is not available for reservations 30 days or longer or reservations that require a security deposit.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
